=== YOUR SEGMENT'S UNCOVERED LIST (segment 3: Storms) ===
# Storms
  ¶1 PARTIAL (uncovered in CAPS): A WRECK ON THE ROCKS WAS THE KEEPER'S failure, whatever the weather.
  ¶2 PARTIAL (uncovered in CAPS): THE KEEPER stayed at the lamp (in 1839, for nine days) through every gale.
  ¶3 UNCOVERED: I have stood in that lamp room in a gale, and the glass shook.
=== END ===
